answer: A payout is split which means 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The willow schedule is applied in pearl and whisper exposes each instalment. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3480 identities would post 2801 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
